name: Lockport (United States)
description: Dark red field charged with concentric rings in tan and dark red, crossed by a light blue wavy stripe for the Illinois and Michigan Canal.
history: Lockport is a city in Will County, Illinois, located 30 miles southwest of Chicago. The flag was adopted on 16 October 2024 (approved by the Lockport City Council on 16 October 2024, designed by a committee led by an eighth-grader, Zachary Dylkiewicz, as an Eagle Scout project, according to Flags of the World).
